lesson.text: Quick memory: what does a red diamond on a bottle mean? (Danger: don't touch.) Today: the warning signs, the child lock, and never mixing.
The red diamonds are used in many countries. Corrosive hurts skin and eyes; toxic (the skull) is very dangerous; flammable (the flame) catches fire; the exclamation mark means harmful.
Cleaners and medicines live up high, in a cupboard with a child lock: close it, press until it clicks, pull to check it holds.
Never mix cleaners. Some, like bleach with other cleaners, make a harmful gas that hurts eyes and lungs. Grown-ups use one at a time, with the window open.

steps.text: One at a time, window open

lesson.text: A swallowed button battery is an emergency: it can hurt inside within two hours. A grown-up calls the emergency number at once.
Never eat wild mushrooms or berries: poisonous ones can look just like safe ones, and even experts can be fooled.
Try it in the world: open the practice kitchen and garage. Next: carbon monoxide and emergencies, on the Big track.

exercises.prompt: A red diamond with a flame means...
You can mix two cleaners to make a super cleaner.
exercises.explain: False: never mix cleaners. Some make a harmful gas.

exercises.prompt: Where do cleaners and medicines live?
exercises.explain: Up high, in a cupboard with a child lock.

exercises.prompt: Locking the child lock: put it in order.
exercises.explain: Close the door, press until it clicks, pull to check it holds.
Toxic: very dangerous if swallowed, breathed in or on the skin.

exercises.prompt: A swallowed button battery is an emergency.
exercises.explain: True: it can hurt inside within two hours. Call the emergency number.

exercises.prompt: A friend offers you their headache tablet. You...
choices: say no: medicine only from my grown-up
exercises.explain: Say no: only your own grown-up gives you medicine.

exercises.prompt: A bottle has no label. To find out what is inside, you...
exercises.explain: Ask a grown-up: never sniff or taste to find out.
Locks and your grown-up's medicine are safe; mixing and wild mushrooms are not.

exercises.prompt: Why can't you just pick the mushrooms that look safe?
choices: poisonous ones look like safe ones
exercises.explain: Poisonous mushrooms can look just like safe ones.

exercises.prompt: Antifreeze for the car can smell sweet, so it is safe.
exercises.hint: A sweet smell can trick you.
exercises.explain: False: it is very dangerous. Keep it up high and locked away.
